title: Why Blood Banks Need Every Type Of Donor
hook: A hospital's blood supply only works when its donors reflect everyone.
closing: A broad donor pool gives hospitals better odds of finding every needed match.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB negative belongs to just 1 percent of Americans. A blood bank needs rare donors as well as common ones.
Only 15 percent of Americans are Rh negative. That smaller donor pool makes negative matches harder to replace.
O positive reaches 53 percent among Latin American donors. Donor diversity changes which blood types hospitals can supply.
